Solutions Architect

Job Details

Posted 29 July 2026
LocationWellington
Job type Contracting & Consulting Solutions
Discipline IT, Transformation & Digital

Job Description

We're building our talent pool of experienced Solution Architects across Application, Infrastructure, and Cloud domains for upcoming enterprise-scale transformation programmes.

If you're passionate about designing robust, scalable, and future-ready technology solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

We're interested in professionals with experience in:
  • Defining end-to-end solution architectures aligned to business and technology strategies
  • Leading technical design across complex enterprise environments
  • Engaging with business stakeholders, delivery teams, and vendors to shape solution outcomes
  • Producing architecture artefacts, roadmaps, and technical documentation
  • Ensuring solutions meet security, compliance, performance, and operational requirements

Application Solution Architects
  • Enterprise application architecture and integration design
  • API, microservices, and modern application platforms
  • Digital, ERP, CRM, and business system transformation initiatives
  • Azure, AWS, or hybrid application environments
Infrastructure Solution Architects
  • Enterprise infrastructure design and modernization
  • Networks, compute, storage, virtualization, and end-user environments
  • Data centre migrations and technology refresh programmes
  • High availability, resilience, and disaster recovery solutions
Cloud Solution Architects
  • Azure, AWS, or multi-cloud architecture
  • Cloud migration, modernization, and optimisation
  • Landing zones, governance, security, and DevOps practices
  • Cloud-native platforms and automation
What we're looking for:
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Experience working within large enterprise or government environments
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into practical technology solutions
  • Relevant architecture certifications (TOGAF, Azure, AWS, etc.) highly regarded

Please contact Lorraine Toppo at lorraine.toppo@beyond.co.nz or 021 965 429 quoting job ref: 133087.
